elements.requirement: Section 297C applies if a forfeiture notice is given in respect of any cash.
elements.quote: This section applies if a forfeiture notice is given in respect of any cash.

elements.requirement: Cash subject to a forfeiture notice must be detained until the cash is forfeited under section 297C, the notice lapses under section 297C, or the cash is released under a power conferred by this Chapter.
elements.quote: The cash is to be detained until— (a) the cash is forfeited under this section, (b) the notice lapses under this section, or (c) the cash is released under a power conferred by this Chapter.

elements.requirement: The cash is forfeited (subject to section 297E) if no objection is made within the period for objecting and the forfeiture notice has not lapsed.
elements.quote: If no objection is made within the period for objecting, and the notice has not lapsed, the cash is forfeited (subject to section 297E).

elements.requirement: A forfeiture notice lapses if an objection is made within the period for objecting.
elements.quote: If an objection is made within the period for objecting, the notice lapses.

elements.requirement: A forfeiture notice lapses if an application is made under section 298 for the forfeiture of the whole or any part of the cash.
elements.quote: If an application is made for the forfeiture of the whole or any part of the cash under section 298, the notice lapses.

elements.requirement: A forfeiture notice lapses or, as the case may be, lapses in relation to that part if the cash or any part of it is released under a power conferred by this Chapter.
elements.quote: If the cash or any part of it is released under a power conferred by this Chapter, the notice lapses or (as the case may be) lapses in relation to that part.

elements.requirement: An objection may be made by anyone, regardless of whether that person is a recipient of the forfeiture notice or not.
elements.quote: An objection may be made by anyone, whether a recipient of the notice or not.

elements.requirement: An objection means a written objection sent to the address specified in the forfeiture notice.
elements.quote: An objection means a written objection sent to the address specified in the notice

elements.requirement: An objection is made when it is received at the address specified in the notice.
elements.quote: an objection is made when it is received at the address.

elements.requirement: An objection does not prevent forfeiture of the cash under section 298.
elements.quote: An objection does not prevent forfeiture of the cash under section 298.

elements.requirement: Nothing in section 297C affects the validity of an order made under section 295(2).
elements.quote: Nothing in this section affects the validity of an order under section 295(2).
